verdict.rationale: The Drive REST API covers the core actions a user takes in the UI: simple, multipart and resumable uploads, listing and searching files, file metadata and custom properties, and sharing with the same user/group/domain/anyone roles the UI exposes. It also offers change feeds and push notifications, and third-party tools like rclone use it to pull all content out of Drive. However, nothing in the evidence states or demonstrates full UI-to-API parity, and some UI features (e.g., OCR search) have no API evidence. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party parity statement or coverage map, API evidence for UI-only features like OCR, and independent hands-on confirmation that no UI action is missing from the API.
